title: 9-Year Hustle to Achieve a Single GoalㅣNotion's Cofounders
description:
This is the co-founders' story of Notion, Akshay Kothari(COO) and Ivan Zhao(CEO), building Notion.

Notion is one of the most innovative productivity tools worldwide to make every human able to build their own software without coding. 

Before co-founding Notion, Akshay built Pulse, which is RSS based news curation app, and Ivan was a designer from Canada just after college graduation.

00:34 Akshay's background
03:15 Notion's first failure
06:21 Notion's PMF story
12:05 Notion's culture and core values
